name: wdn-sensor-placement-benchmark
description: First public release of the research package for reproducible comparison of DQN, PPO, DDPG, and Genetic Algorithms (GA) for graph-based sensor placement in water distribution networks. The package includes: Selected source scripts for four-method spatial coverage evaluation and leak/contamination detection. Processed datasets and matched-seed statistical analysis outputs. DQN ablation results and figures. Reproducibility documentation, dependency specifications, and MIT license. Study design: Benchmark networks: Net3, C-Town, and Richmond. Sensor budget: five sensors per placement. Random seeds: 42–51. Spatial coverage evaluated at graph-hop radii 1–4. Statistical analyses use paired comparisons and Holm correction where specified. Limitations: The detection evaluation uses graph-hop criteria and does not establish hydraulic or contaminant-transport validation. The included scripts and dependency specifications have not yet been verified as a complete end-to-end reproduction in a clean environment. Training and optimisation compute budgets were not equal across methods. This release preserves the selected code, data, and analysis outputs associated with the benchmark. Please consult README.md and documentation/reproducibility.md for details.
